prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Account Sign-In Order: Move the sign-in step to occur after selecting and configuring your companion pet, allowing users to experience pet creation before signing in. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right at step 2 before they have experienced pet selection or built an emotional connection.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Primer Screen: Add a dedicated onboarding screen right before entering the home desktop to explain hotkeys, system tray icons, and hiding/showing the pet. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, summon, or temporarily hide their pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Adoption Pledge Screen: Introduce an interactive pet commitment pledge step after certificate generation to clarify pet cloud save binding. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or resetting after re-signing in, while adoption step overall drops off 39.1% of users.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Save Status Note: Add an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen describing how account sign-in protects pet progress from resetting. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in, indicating misunderstanding of account sync.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Step Time Estimate and Background Notification: Enable time estimates and desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen while asset rendering occurs in the background. (why: Waiting step takes a mean time of 2336 seconds; setting clear expectations and background alerts prevents drop-offs.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Display Troubleshooting Banner: Update home intro text and hints to include quick troubleshooting instructions if the pet pet does not render immediately. (why: 3 support tickets reported that pets do not show up on the desktop screen or the app does not open visibly post-setup.)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Choose Path Welcome Mascot Banner: Add a friendly mascot component and setup step counter to the path selection screen to encourage commitment. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path before starting pet setup.)

Addresses 8 support emails on sign_in drop via quick copy hint addition.
